523b948f346238e41d007555_6.spoken: One last thing. Maliit was able to restore the readable surface of one of Green Winters' DVDs. If you'd like to take a look, you will find it sitting beside the player.

523b948f346238e41d007555_18.original:

All that anyone will, truth be told.
523b948f346238e41d007555_18.spoken: Well, I *was* able to recover a file... but unfortunately, that's all that I'll ever be able to pull off of this thing. All that anyone will, truth be told.

$(l.name)... I suspect that Green Winters' predictions are coming true. I believe that Feuerschwinge is behind this.
523b948f346238e41d007555_28.spoken: Well. Our scarred friend makes an appearance. I suspect that Green Winters' predictions are coming true. I believe that Feuerschwinge is behind this.

523b948f346238e41d007555_44.spoken: ...And, as luck would have it, Frau Müller has arrived. Best of luck at the meeting. Remember... this is urgent. We *need* that money.

523b948f346238e41d007555_50.original:

523b948f346238e41d007555_68.spoken: Your attitude is trying. This is *serious.* I'd expect that you'd treat it as such.

523b948f346238e41d007555_74.original:

523b948f346238e41d007555_74.spoken: I have new information. I'm afraid that the news isn't good.

523b948f346238e41d007555_89.spoken: That much goes without saying. This development worries me. It worries me greatly.

Apparently, Frau Müller surreptitiously recorded your meeting. She claims that she has added your voiceprint to the Aztechnology database.
523b948f346238e41d007555_106.spoken: One last thing. Frau Müller sent me a message while you were on the OTK run. 523b948f346238e41d007555_132.spoken: You've never been up against one of their High Threat Response Teams. Be thankful for that.

523b948f346238e41d007555_147.spoken: That said, we believe that Monika’s friend is the right choice to lead the team.

523b948f346238e41d007555_170.spoken: Monika’s friend will take her place as the leader of this team.

When Monika brought you on board, I was initially unsure about you. I would never have said that to anyone else, of course... but I kept you under a watchful eye.

I can see now that I needn't have doubted her judgment. She chose her successor well.
523b948f346238e41d007555_217.spoken: I have to say... this lifts an enormous weight off of my shoulders. When Monika brought you on board, I was initially unsure about you. 523b948f346238e41d007555_219.spoken: You know... I have no idea why Monika chose you as a friend. You are rude, condescending, and arrogant. But your skills in the shadows are unparalleled. And for that, I suppose, I am thankful.

523b948f346238e41d007555_263.spoken: What can I do for you?

If you trip an alarm now, Knight Errant will be on you before you can blink.
523f37cb303031540c003c07_0.spoken: Well, it couldn't last forever. It looks as though the Azzies have sorted out that overload that you fed into their power grid. Watch your step, my friend. Get the job done and get out, $(l.name). I'll be waiting for you.
523f37cb303031540c003c07_1.spoken: Best to keep moving. The control panel for the generators can't be far from your location. When you reach it, the password "Xolotl" should allow you to disengage their safety overrides. Get the job done and get out. I'll be waiting for you.

523f37cb303031540c003c07_3.spoken: .. there's no easy way to say this. I'm afraid that the Knight Errant High Threat Response Team is on its way.

523f37cb303031540c003c07_4.original:
Move quickly. Speed is your only advantage now. When you reach the generators' control panel, the password "Xolotl" should allow you to disengage their safety overrides.

Get the job done and get out, $(l.name). I'll be waiting for you.
523f37cb303031540c003c07_4.spoken: Move quickly. Speed is your only advantage now. When you reach the generators' control panel, the password "Xolotl" should allow you to disengage their safety overrides. Get the job done and get out. I'll be waiting for you.

Keep moving, $(l.name). You're almost there.

523f37cb303031540c003c07_5.spoken: Keep moving. You're almost there. When you reach the control panel for the generators, the password "Xolotl" should allow you to disengage their safety overrides.

5241f138303031b415002dbf_0.spoken: That's done it! The generators are set to blow! Well done making it all the way there undetected... I wouldn't have thought it possible.

5241f138303031b415002dbf_1.spoken: Now, on to the bad news... I'm seeing a huge spike in comm traffic. Get your team out of there. Not only is the building set to blow, but enemy reinforcements are on the way!

Set the building's generators to overload, then hightail it back here. I'll keep both eyes open for enemy activity.
5242587a30303104140013df_0.spoken: Your mission objective is to bring down the building. If you leave without doing so, this entire enterprise will have been a waste of time. Set the building's generators to overload, then hightail it back here. I'll keep both eyes open for enemy activity.

{{GM}}Amsel shakes his head wearily.{{/GM}}

52449597346238a0240049c3_51.spoken: No. I am not holding out. I am tired, and I am frustrated, and I already miss Monika.

5244c613303031c00e000281_0.original:
Damn. Damn it to hell.

5266eef4663661b825002e69_0.spoken: Did you make contact with Alice?

5266eef4663661b825002e69_4.original:
I will never forget.

Don't worry, $(l.name). I'm going to conduct my investigation the old fashioned way... through contacts, and deduction, and careful observation.

I will not jack in to the Matrix until this entire sorry episode is finished.
5266eef4663661b825002e69_4.spoken: I will never forget. Don't worry. I'm going to conduct my investigation the old fashioned way... through contacts, and deduction, and careful observation. I will not jack in to the Matrix until this entire sorry episode is finished.

5266eef4663661b825002e69_7.spoken: One last thing before you go. Samuel Beckenbauer wanted me to pass a message to you. Do you know him? The ork who runs the shelter across the way?

5266eef4663661b825002e69_9.original:
It's my job to be on top of things, $(l.name). You needn't worry about me on that count.

You also don't need to worry about our mysterious Matrix killer... at least, not insofar as I am concerned. I won't step near a jackpoint until this entire sorry episode is over.
5266eef4663661b825002e69_9.spoken: It's my job to be on top of things. You needn't worry about me on that count. You also don't need to worry about our mysterious Matrix killer... at least, not insofar as I am concerned. I won't step near a jackpoint until this entire sorry episode is over.

Yes... $(l.name) is right. Finding Dr. Vauclair should be our priority.

5266eef4663661b825002e69_21.spoken: Yes... our friend here is right. Finding Dr. Vauclair should be our priority. If we're going up against a dragon, we need to find ourselves a dragonslayer.

5266eef4663661b825002e69_30.spoken: An encoded credstick, yes. 10,000 nuyen. Alice will not show her face for less. This represents the last of my personal savings. Make this meeting count.

52376ac7303031a81700022b_4.original:

523c8edc346238e41d008a48_1.spoken: Let me get right to business. My organization would like to retain your services for the indefinite future. But first, we're asking you to go on a trial run - an "audition" of sorts - to prove that you're the right man for the job.

523c8edc346238e41d008a48_18.original:
For a $(l.man) of your talents, it should be.

523c8edc346238e41d008a48_23.original:
After you have planted the devices and verified that they work, come back to me. There will be a brief interview - a post-mortem on the run, if you like - and, assuming that I am satisfied with what I hear, I will pay you your first stipend. Then we will discuss our future options.

Best of luck, $(l.name). We will be watching.

523c8e98346238e41d008a36_18.spoken: You won't catch sight of me that way. My true self is hidden, tucked away behind a veil of time and aether. Be thankful. You wouldn't like what you'd see.

523c8e98346238e41d008a36_48.spoken: Go now. Talk to Aljernon - after all that has happened, I'm sure that he'll be glad to see you. But remember what I've told you.

There is something that you need to know... a truth hidden from mortal eyes. I need you to understand that I am not mortal so that you will trust my words.

523c8e98346238e41d008a36_64.spoken: Welcome back to Aljernon's. Enjoy your time here in the light. Soon enough, you'll be wallowing in darkness.

53e3fba73030318c1f0077be_0.spoken: Unbelievable. We have one job to do in this place, and our fearless leader wants to bail before we've done it. Get your ass back here, "team leader." We still have a penthouse to bug, remember?

5260599e303031cc10006e09_31.original:
Best of luck with that. Even as we speak, loyal Soldiers of Humanity are converging on this position.

Get ready to die, $(l.race).
5260599e303031cc10006e09_31.spoken: Best of luck with that. Even as we speak, loyal Soldiers of Humanity are converging on this position. Get ready to die, mongrel.

5260599e303031cc10006e09_40.original:
It's a little late for that, $(l.race). You've just brought me the last of what I need.

That gas that you hauled in for us... it's gonna prove every word that we've been saying. The trogs, the halfers, the goddamned dandelion-eaters... one whiff of this stuff, and they're gonna tear each other apart. And then they'll spill into the good, *human* neighborhoods, where we'll be waiting to stop them.
5260599e303031cc10006e09_40.spoken: It's a little late for that, mongrel. You've just brought me the last of what I need. That gas that you hauled in for us... it's gonna prove every word that we've been saying. The trogs, the halfers, the goddamned dandelion-eaters... one whiff of this stuff, and they're gonna tear each other apart. And then they'll spill into the good, human neighborhoods, where we'll be waiting to stop them.

5260599e303031cc10006e09_70.spoken: There. That's better. I have shown you hospitality. Now it's time for you to return the favor. So tell me: why are you here?

52152ed0663661680f0001ec_9.original:
Ah. A pity. But it's your loss.

Good day, $(l.name).
52152ed0663661680f0001ec_9.spoken: Ah. A pity. But it's your loss. Good day.

525c3d08303031d410005d43_1.spoken: Damn it. I knew this was gonna happen. I fuckin' knew it. Everybody pile out of the van. And get ready... we're gonna need some muscle in a second.

525c3d08303031d410005d43_10.spoken: Maybe I was wrong. Maybe this *does* need to get violent. Get ready to ventilate these assholes. We've got a schedule to keep.

525c3d08303031d410005d43_25.spoken: I like you. You're gonna go far in this business.

525d6f9e303031bc0a0072cd_1.original:
I've gotta admit, $(l.name)... this attack has made me nervous. We're running late, we're low on ammo, and there's no time to call for reinforcements.

Whichever way you slice it, we won't be going into this meet at our best.
525d6f9e303031bc0a0072cd_1.spoken: I've gotta admit... this attack has made me nervous. We're running late, we're low on ammo, and there's no time to call for reinforcements. Whichever way you slice it, we won't be going into this meet at our best.

525d6f9e303031bc0a0072cd_6.original:
Yeah, well, trust me. It happens.

I'm just glad that I had you here to cover me. Always good to have a competent $(l.man) at your back.
525d6f9e303031bc0a0072cd_6.spoken: Yeah, well, trust me. It happens. I'm just glad that I had you here to cover me. Always good to have a competent man at your back.

525ddfa63030310818005fa5_5.original:
This puts us in a bad spot, $(l.name).

I'm not sure what our next step is.
525ddfa63030310818005fa5_5.spoken: This puts us in a bad spot. I'm not sure what our next step is.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_141.spoken: Anyway, just thought you'd want to share in the good news. And thanks for your help back there... I don't think we'd've made it out of there without you. Take care.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_191.spoken: Anyway, just thought you'd want to share in the good news. And thanks for your help back there... I don't think we'd've made it out of there without you. Take care.

525f202330303154160067d0_6.original: Yeah, I suppose... might not be a bad idea for you to look into that, $(l.name).
525f202330303154160067d0_6.spoken: Yeah, I suppose... might not be a bad idea for you to look into that.

52ab4537643431431fd37135_8.original:
Nice to meet you, $(l.name).
	
Now that I’ve said my bit, what are you doing in a place like this?
52ab4537643431431fd37135_8.spoken: Nice to meet you. Now that I’ve said my bit, what are you doing in a place like this?

52ab4537643431431fd37135_21.original: Can I at least buy something for my friend here? $(l.he)’s been talking with me a bit and hasn’t had anything.
52ab4537643431431fd37135_21.spoken: Can I at least buy something for my friend here? They are been talking with me a bit and hasn’t had anything.

528519976261640406004f03_64.original: Excellent, $(scene.iNumMagnifikerToSell) amulets means $(scene.iBountyToCollect) nuyen in your pocket.
528519976261640406004f03_64.spoken: Excellent, that many amulets means a tidy pile of nuyen in your pocket.

528519976261640406004f03_88.spoken: Big mistake, man. BIG mistake. C'MON, BOYS! Let's show this PARASITE who's boss.

52532b32626164681700018f_29.original:
Forget the trinket, $(l.name). We need the money.

Fifteen thousand nuyen is a lot to give up, and the hit to our reputation will be even worse.
52532b32626164681700018f_29.spoken: Forget the trinket. We need the money. Fifteen thousand nuyen is a lot to give up, and the hit to our reputation will be even worse.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_146.original:
>>*Enstad, Thorvald*
>>to: $(l.name)

Hey there, pal! After our run-in, I decided to do a little diggin', and I came up with your address. Hope you don't mind that I'm writin' ya, but I thought we should keep in touch!
527abf9e636134b83400302e_146.spoken: Hey there, pal! After our run-in, I decided to do a little diggin', and I came up with your address. Hope you don't mind that I'm writin' ya, but I thought we should keep in touch!

527abf9e636134b83400302e_147.original:
Anyway, I went on this run the other day, and I've just been DYING to share the story with someone!

You *understand* me, so I thought that "someone" might as well be you!
527abf9e636134b83400302e_147.spoken: Anyway, I went on this run the other day, and I've just been DYING to share the story with someone! You *understand* me, so I thought that "someone" might as well be you!

527abf9e636134b83400302e_148.original:
So this was a solo job, right? Not really even a shadowrun... more of hired killing, to be honest. Just like the one you were on when we met!

Well, my target was the manager of this junkyard. Lots of big, heavy equipment, just waitin' to be used. He even had this custom WALDO unit... all these robot arms, each with its own special tool for a hand.
527abf9e636134b83400302e_148.spoken: So this was a solo job, right? Not really even a shadowrun... more of hired killing, to be honest. Just like the one you were on when we met! Well, my target was the manager of this junkyard. Lots of big, heavy equipment, just waitin' to be used. He even had this custom WALDO unit... all these robot arms, each with its own special tool for a hand.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_149.original:
It had drills, and saws, and cutting torches... even a belt sander! The thing could strip and part out a car in two minutes flat!

You can see where this is going, right? Yeah, I know that you can!
527abf9e636134b83400302e_149.spoken: It had drills, and saws, and cutting torches... even a belt sander! The thing could strip and part out a car in two minutes flat! You can see where this is going, right? Yeah, I know that you can!

527abf9e636134b83400302e_150.original: You should've been there, buddy, I'm tellin' you. It was like somethin' out of a goddamned horror movie, only *better,* because *I* was in charge of the whole show. And no security to show up and spoil my fun, neither!
527abf9e636134b83400302e_150.spoken: You should've been there, buddy, I'm tellin' you. It was like somethin' out of a goddamned horror movie, only *better,* because *I* was in charge of the whole show. And no security to show up and spoil my fun, neither!

527abf9e636134b83400302e_151.original:
Anyway, pal, I guess I've taken up enough of your time. But thanks again for lettin' me go!

\m/
-ThOrvald
527abf9e636134b83400302e_151.spoken: Anyway, pal, I guess I've taken up enough of your time. But thanks again for lettin' me go!

52af576d6161362808001bbe_4.spoken: Well, what would you call them?

52af576d6161362808001bbe_27.original: Oh, there's no need. Word gets around. You're $(l.name).
52af576d6161362808001bbe_27.spoken: Oh, there's no need. Word gets around. We know who you are.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_88.original:
{{GM}}Karin turns red in the face, positively fuming.{{/GM}}

We know she was beaten. Assaulted by some cowardly drug dealer. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_88.spoken: We know she was beaten. Assaulted by some cowardly drug dealer.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_90.original: Fine. What we heard is that someone came advertising cheaper BTLs than what our resident Mr. Flash provides. It got Kim's attention. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_90.spoken: Fine. What we heard is that someone came advertising cheaper BTLs than what our resident Mr. Flash provides. It got Kim's attention.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_215.original: "We"? Mein Schatz, either we are in the presence of royalty, or $(l.he) has decided to keep on.
52af576d6161362808001bbe_215.spoken: "We"? Mein Schatz, either we are in the presence of royalty, or they have decided to keep on.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_221.original: I think the Flux may have $(l.him), mein Schatz.
52af576d6161362808001bbe_221.spoken: I think the Flux may have them, mein Schatz.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_92.original: He's not the type, Kristian. We know him. Zaak is hardly an angel, but he is not capable of that kind of violence. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_92.spoken: He's not the type, Kristian. We know him. Zaak is hardly an angel, but he is not capable of that kind of violence.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_95.original: If you believe she chose that life, then you are the naive one. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_95.spoken: If you believe she chose that life, then you are the naive one.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_98.original: And people say I am the naive one. Mein Schatz, we've seen life in the other kieze. Pimps and dealers who use fear and violence to cow others into submission. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_98.spoken: And people say I am the naive one. Mein Schatz, we've seen life in the other kieze. Pimps and dealers who use fear and violence to cow others into submission.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_100.original: No resident of the Kreuzbasar would have done such a thing when Monika was in charge. To think those impulses ever existed and now are free to be expressed... (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_100.spoken: No resident of the Kreuzbasar would have done such a thing when Monika was in charge. To think those impulses ever existed and now are free to be expressed...

52af576d6161362808001bbe_106.original: Or he was trying to kill him, which would surely give Samuel cause to react. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_106.spoken: Or he was trying to kill him, which would surely give Samuel cause to react.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_112.original: But he has made a vow. He will not take up arms again. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_112.spoken: But he has made a vow. He will not take up arms again.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_119.original: I remember hearing the reports of the anarchists burning City Hall, and seeing the smoke over the rooftops. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_119.spoken: I remember hearing the reports of the anarchists burning City Hall, and seeing the smoke over the rooftops.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_121.original: We were sure it was only a matter of time before the government or the corporations regained control. So we waited. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_121.spoken: We were sure it was only a matter of time before the government or the corporations regained control. So we waited.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_123.original: The government did nothing! They wrote the city off as a loss. Probably figured the whole anarchist movement would bury itself in time, saving them the trouble. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_123.spoken: The government did nothing! They wrote the city off as a loss. Probably figured the whole anarchist movement would bury itself in time, saving them the trouble.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_130.original: Others we tried were worse. One even kicked us out because of our age. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_130.spoken: Others we tried were worse. One even kicked us out because of our age.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_131.original: At times we regretted staying on this side of the walls. But then we found the Kreuzbasar, and we were home. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_131.spoken: At times we regretted staying on this side of the walls. But then we found the Kreuzbasar, and we were home.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_134.original: Few things appear to be routine these days. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_134.spoken: Few things appear to be routine these days.

52af576d6161362808001bbe_135.original: Oh, we're fine. Thanks for checking on us. (w)
52af576d6161362808001bbe_135.spoken: Oh, we're fine. Thanks for checking on us.

521d44a83030319015005ab9_23.spoken: Oh, thank God. And thank you, too. Give them the spare keycard that Danni bought. They are going to fix this for us.

521e77003030318403005ff8_41.original: Come on, $(l.man). Help us out, here.
521e77003030318403005ff8_41.spoken: Come on, man. Help us out, here.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_136.original:
Hey, $(l.name)! That "fireworks display" that *mysteriously* went off at the Azzie compound was a thing of beauty!

We wish you could've been in the coffee shop with us to see it, but we understand that you had more important things to do.
527abf9e636134b83400302e_136.spoken: Hey! That "fireworks display" that *mysteriously* went off at the Azzie compound was a thing of beauty! We wish you could've been in the coffee shop with us to see it, but we understand that you had more important things to do.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_182.original:
Hey, $(l.name)! That "fireworks display" that *mysteriously* went off at the Azzie compound was a thing of beauty!

523b9421346238e41d00754c_0.original:
$(l.name). I'm glad to see that you made it through the attack.

Not all of mine were so lucky.
523b9421346238e41d00754c_0.spoken: My friend. I'm glad to see that you made it through the attack. Not all of mine were so lucky.

523b9421346238e41d00754c_4.original:
$(l.name). It does me good to know that you're still fightin' the good fight.

You just tell me what you need, and my boys'll go fetch it for you.
523b9421346238e41d00754c_4.spoken: My friend. It does me good to know that you're still fightin' the good fight. You just tell me what you need, and my boys'll go fetch it for you.

523b9421346238e41d00754c_25.original:
And one more thing, $(l.name)... I'm gonna need you to go in light on this one. Take a friend along if you like, but no more than one. If you spook 'em, they could trash the merchandise. Best go quiet. 

Best go soon, too, before the trail goes cold.
523b9421346238e41d00754c_25.spoken: And one more thing... I'm gonna need you to go in light on this one. Take a friend along if you like, but no more than one. If you spook 'em, they could trash the merchandise. Best go quiet. Best go soon, too, before the trail goes cold.

523b9421346238e41d00754c_34.original:
{{GM}}The Romani patriarch gives you an approving nod.{{/GM}}

Until then, $(l.name).

523b9421346238e41d00754c_41.original:
Here is your payment, then. It is at least good to know that our shipments will be safe again.

Until next time, $(l.name).
523b9421346238e41d00754c_41.spoken: Here is your payment, then. It is at least good to know that our shipments will be safe again. Until next time.

523b9421346238e41d00754c_49.original:
T'aven baxtale, $(l.race).

You're here to conduct some business? If so, I welcome you to Mettbach Arms and Ammunition. If not, keep right on walking.
523b9421346238e41d00754c_49.spoken: T'aven baxtale, stranger. You're here to conduct some business? If so, I welcome you to Mettbach Arms and Ammunition. If not, keep right on walking.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_126.original:
>>*Mettbach, Gunari*
>>to: $(l.name)

If you value new hardware coming into the Kreuzbasar, we need to talk. One of my weapons shipments was hijacked by a local gang. I can promise 500 nuyen - and if you can recover the shipment, I'll have some new gear on the shelf.

Come see me for the details.

If you are receiving this message, I have fled the country or am otherwise unavailable.

Don't worry, you'll still be getting paid... I've made the appropriate preparations.

527abf9e636134b83400302e_235.original:

Goodbye,
Ivonne Jimenez, aka "Frau Müller"

Goodbye,
Ivonne Jimenez, aka "Frau Müller"

52b0f33b636134f804001950_2.original: $(l.name), I presume? Herr Amsel told me that I could meet you here.
52b0f33b636134f804001950_2.spoken: I presume? Herr Amsel told me that I could meet you here.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_11.original:
I’ve seen many terrible things in my life, $(l.name). In Tenochtitlan, blood magic is commonplace.

Take a moment to imagine what that means.
52b0f33b636134f804001950_11.spoken: I’ve seen many terrible things in my life. In Tenochtitlan, blood magic is commonplace. Take a moment to imagine what that means.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_13.spoken: Seeing such things… it changes you. Makes you numb. But what I found when I arrived here was worse. This project… it horrifies me. And it must be stopped.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_20.original:
So tell me, $(l.name). Is there anything more that you need to hear from me?

Or are you ready to make a decision?
52b0f33b636134f804001950_20.spoken: So tell me. Is there anything more that you need to hear from me? Or are you ready to make a decision?

52b0f33b636134f804001950_22.original:
I had to meet you in person. To look into your eyes and see the $(l.man) behind the name.

Now that I have done so, I am sure. You are the one that I need.
52b0f33b636134f804001950_22.spoken: I had to meet you in person. To look into your eyes and see the man behind the name. Now that I have done so, I am sure. You are the one that I need.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_24.original:
None of us are innocent, $(l.name).

But if you need to salve your conscience, rest assured that at the hour of your approach, the only personnel authorized to be on site will be security and senior members of the research team. And I assure you... neither are innocent in this matter. If the Bloodline project reaches completion, nobody will be safe ever again.
52b0f33b636134f804001950_24.spoken: None of us are innocent. And I assure you... neither are innocent in this matter. If the Bloodline project reaches completion, nobody will be safe ever again.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_33.original: It's better than fair. I've done my homework, $(l.name).
52b0f33b636134f804001950_33.spoken: It's better than fair. I've done my homework.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_35.spoken: In that case, it's a deal! I can't tell you how relieved I am... thank you for helping me to bring this nightmare to an end.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_36.original:
I will iron out the remaining details with your Herr Amsel. He'll want to talk this over with you anyway, I'm sure.

You're a good $(l.man), $(l.name). You are saving more lives than you know.
52b0f33b636134f804001950_36.spoken: I will iron out the remaining details with your Herr Amsel. He'll want to talk this over with you anyway, I'm sure. You're a good man. You are saving more lives than you know.

52b0f33b636134f804001950_42.original:
If you had seen the things that I've seen, you'd understand how foolish you sound.

Of *course* there is evil in this world, $(l.name). I'm not talking about the petty viciousness of the human race. I'm talking about true, supernatural evil.

It came back with the Awakening. And denying its existence won't protect you from it.

I'm not talking about the petty viciousness of the human race. I'm talking about true, supernatural evil. It came back with the Awakening. And denying its existence won't protect you from it.

523b74fe346238e41d00704a_2.spoken: That was crazy. Bullets flyin', people dropping like flies... crazy.

523b74fe346238e41d00704a_6.spoken: One of these days. Absolutely. But today, you're here for a reason. What can ol' Zaak get for you?

523b74fe346238e41d00704a_8.spoken: Guten Tag. You here for some magic? Because Zaak Flash......is your magic man.

523b74fe346238e41d00704a_42.original: Welcome back, $(l.freund). What can ol' Zaak getcha?

523be886346238e41d007cef_0.spoken: The attack... it was terrible. So much death. I had not killed since I retired from running the shadows. Not until today.

<Marta. We welcome you back to our domain, child.>

{{GM}}It speaks in a chorus of clear, lilting voices. You don't hear them so much as *feel* them; the sensation is strange, like hundreds of butterflies fluttering in your chest.{{/GM}}

<You will remain silent until you are addressed. Do you understand?>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_1.spoken: Marta. We welcome you back to our domain, child. You will remain silent until you are addressed. Do you understand?

53594e5c303031b40a000145_3.original:
<Good.>

{{GM}}The fluttering feeling swells, and you feel your knees go weak. Marta sobs with joy.{{/GM}}

53594e5c303031b40a000145_4.original:
<Glory. Welcome, child.>

<What a pleasure it is to see you again.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_4.spoken: Glory. Welcome, child. What a pleasure it is to see you again.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_6.original:
<Glory. Welcome, child.>

{{GM}}It speaks in a chorus of clear, lilting voices. You don't hear them so much as *feel* them; the sensation is strange, like hundreds of butterflies fluttering in your chest.{{/GM}}

<What a pleasure it is to see you again.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_6.spoken: Glory. Welcome, child. What a pleasure it is to see you again.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_10.spoken: We are not in need of help. We are our Great Master's servant, just as Harrow is. Just as you are, despite your misguided attempt to cut away His love from your heart.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_11.spoken: You have mangled yourself beyond repair, and you did it to spite Him. He, who was your greatest benefactor... you betrayed Him, child. But He loves you, all the same.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_13.original:
<Your friend - this outsider - jokes at our Great Master's expense. But we take no offense.

$+(l.hisher) words are like the babble of a newborn babe. $+(l.he) is ignorant of the truth.>

{{GM}}The spirit inclines its head toward you.{{/GM}}

<If the noise continues, we will educate $(l.him), and the babble will cease.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_13.spoken: Your friend - this outsider - jokes at our Great Master's expense. But we take no offense. Their words are like the babble of a newborn babe. They are ignorant of the truth. If the noise continues, we will educate them, and the babble will cease.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_15.original:
<I have a message for you from our Great Master.

He has a gift for you. A peace offering. One that He offers freely.

A sign of His continued affection for you.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_15.spoken: I have a message for you from our Great Master. He has a gift for you. A peace offering. One that He offers freely. A sign of His continued affection for you.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_16.original:
<He knows that you desire His servant's destruction. As a symbol of His love, He will grant you the power to bring an end to Harrow.

He knows that you wish to free the children of Feuerstelle. As a sign of His compassion, He will help you set them free.

You can have everything that you want, child. All of this and more.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_16.spoken: He knows that you desire His servant's destruction. As a symbol of His love, He will grant you the power to bring an end to Harrow. He knows that you wish to free the children of Feuerstelle. As a sign of His compassion, He will help you set them free. You can have everything that you want, child. All of this and more.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_18.spoken: This will cost you nothing. A simple gesture, a trifle... a show of good faith. If you demonstrate your love for Him, He will reward you beyond your wildest dreams. Remove the protective ward from your neck, and His gift is yours for the taking. Yours forevermore.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_19.spoken: All that He requires of you is a show of good faith. Remove the protective ward from your neck, and His gift is yours for the taking. Yours forevermore.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_23.spoken: If you rebuke our Great Master a second time, I will chew what's left of you into mulch. The marrow from your bones will nourish the garden. I promise you this, child. I promise it.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_26.spoken: Very well, child. If pain is what you seek, we will bring it to you.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_28.original:
<DEATH COMES IN MANY FORMS, CHILD.>

{{GM}}The fluttering sensation in your chest grows into a rasping pain that steals the breath from your lungs. It feels like you're being eaten alive.{{/GM}}

<YOURS WILL BE SWIFT AND BRUTAL.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_28.spoken: DEATH COMES IN MANY FORMS, CHILD. YOURS WILL BE SWIFT AND BRUTAL.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_36.original:
<The outsider may do whatever $(l.he) wishes. We will not interfere with $(l.him) unless $(l.he) provokes us.

Our Great Master's offer was to you, child. Accept, and everything that you desire will be yours.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_36.spoken: The outsider may do whatever they wish. We will not interfere with them unless they provoke us. Our Great Master's offer was to you, child. Accept, and everything that you desire will be yours.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_38.spoken: If you rebuke our Great Master a second time, I will chew what's left of you into mulch. The marrow from your bones will nourish the garden. I promise you this, child. I promise it.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_39.spoken: Your friend will remain here, I think. With me. I can find all manner of uses for such a succulent morsel.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_40.original:
{{GM}}It spreads its arms in supplication.{{/GM}} 

<Prosper or perish - the choice is yours. Embrace His love and have all of your wishes granted, or turn away from it and be destroyed.>
53594e5c303031b40a000145_40.spoken: Prosper or perish - the choice is yours. Embrace His love and have all of your wishes granted, or turn away from it and be destroyed.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_51.spoken: Your friend - this outsider - speaks out of turn. But we take no offense. Their words are like the babble of a newborn babe. They are ignorant of the truth. If the noise continues, we will teach them, and the babble will cease.

53594e5c303031b40a000145_54.spoken: We knew why you had come, child. When you mutilated yourself - when you *cut away* your connection to Him - all became clear to us. We knew that one day you'd be back, and that you would lash out against our Great Master. It was inevitable.

5359caba3030316403004de3_11.spoken: What... what has happened to us? What have we done?

5359caba3030316403004de3_18.original:
{{GM}}The spirit stares at Glory for a long moment. Finally, it dips its head in a nod.{{/GM}}

<Yes. We will help you.>

5359caba3030316403004de3_19.original:

{{GM}}The spirit bows its head.{{/GM}}

5359caba3030316403004de3_19.spoken: We have already done so. The cultists of Feuerstelle are themselves again. We... we wish to do more. We have much to atone for, as you said.

5359caba3030316403004de3_21.spoken: No. But the stone will. We are still bound to this shrine. Anchored here. We can do nothing without your help.

5359caba3030316403004de3_23.original:

5359caba3030316403004de3_40.spoken: We have withdrawn ourselves from the minds of the people here. They are themselves again.

5359caba3030316403004de3_42.spoken: Wait! We... we wish to do more. We have much to atone for, as you said.

538d1793303031a8080076fc_4.spoken: Your suffering has only just begun. We will grind your body to dust.
